    Get agency-, state-, region-, or national-level police staffing data.

    Source: R/police_employment.R
    get_police_employment.Rd

    Get agency-, state-, region-, or national-level police staffing data.

    get_police_employment(
  ori = NULL,
  state_abb = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  from = "2015",
  to = "2020"
)

    Arguments

    ori

    A string of the 9-character ORI code for the desired agency.

    state_abb

    String for state abbreviation. If `NULL` (default) returns national data.

    from

    Start date in MM-YYYY format (default "01-2015").

    to

    End date in MM-YYYY format (default "12-2020").

    Value

    A data.frame with columns for annual number of employees and officers (also broken up by gender).

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Gets only Oakland Police Department in California
get_police_employment("CA0010900")

# Gets California state-level estimates
get_police_employment(state_abb = "CA")

# Gets national-level estimates
get_police_employment()
} # }
